page_title: Heights AI 3 - AI for Creators | Heights Platform

summary.name: Heights AI 3
summary.one_liner: Heights AI 3 is an AI assistant from Heights Platform that helps creators build and launch online courses, communities, websites, emails and coaching programs.
use_cases: Creating an online course outline and lessons
Building a website without coding or design skills
Sending weekly round-up emails to community members
Getting a marketing plan for a creator business
Connecting your own AI agents to your Heights account
summary.what_it_does: Heights AI 3 is presented as an AI layer for creators who run courses, communities and coaching programs on the Heights Platform. It takes a user from an initial idea through to launch in steps: shaping an offer, generating and editing a website from a described style, automating emails, and suggesting a marketing plan. For communities it is said to generate weekly round-up emails, moderate the community and suggest post ideas. For courses it offers course review, a ready-made outline, video and lesson review, and lesson ideas. A coach feature analyzes the business and sends weekly tasks, and an in-app assistant can see the page being viewed and recommend actions. The Heights MCP lets external agents such as ChatGPT or Claude access an account.
notable: Idea-to-launch workflow covering offer, website, emails and marketing plan
Heights MCP lets ChatGPT, Claude and other agents connect to a creator's account
In-app AI assistant that can see the page you are viewing
Weekly coaching tasks based on business analysis
caveats: Page says Heights AI 3 is 'Coming soon'; the free account gives access to the current version only
Free trial is described as 30 days, after which pricing is not stated on this page
